title: Per-phase LoRA racks - every model a flow runs gets its own cogwheel, its own six slots and its own Input_Lora_PhaseN_i nodes
description: Fabio, 2026-08-23, scoping MPI-567's style problem. A flow can already choose a model PER PHASE (scribble-object picks an SDXL render model AND a Klein blend model), but the LoRA rack is flow-level and SINGULAR: `settingsModel` is one string on the FlowDef and `payload.loraModelId` is one id in commandExecutor, so one flow gets one rack. Fabio's shape: each model selector in the slide-over carries its own small cogwheel that opens Model Settings ON THAT MODEL - so a future three-model flow costs nothing and needs no new UI. Naming settled with him: `Input_Lora_Phase1_1..6`, `Input_Lora_Phase2_1..6`, phase-keyed rather than model-keyed so an any-of slot can swap 4B<->9B without retitling the graph. NOT the Wan `loraStages` shape - that is ONE model with two stacks in one panel, which is the opposite of what this needs.
